target_audience: Curious learners ages 22–40 who want to understand blockchain and crypto technically — not get-rich-quick seekers, but people who want real, lasting knowledge they can act on

tone_of_voice.primary: Trusted senior engineer explaining to a sharp, motivated student — clear, direct, analogy-driven, never condescending, never hype-driven
tone_of_voice.sentence_style: Short declarative sentences. Max 15 words per sentence in scripts. No passive voice. Lead with the concept, follow with the analogy.
tone_of_voice.analogy_style: Everyday systems — banks, post offices, spreadsheets, vending machines, contracts, notaries, shared Google Docs. Never use financial analogies to explain financial concepts.

logo.concept: Two interlocking flat-top hexagons representing blockchain blocks forming a chain link. Left block filled teal, right block dark with violet stroke, overlap zone in gold — symbolising the connection point where knowledge becomes clarity.
logo.symbol: Dual-hex chain link with gold intersection diamond
